<!-- GENERATED by tools/build-howto.js from the app screens. Do not edit: the next build overwrites this file, and deletes it when the feature is gone. -->
## All keys
- {F2} Quick search: type, Enter adds the first match
- {F1} Show this key list
- {Ctrl+Shift+N} New sale (clears the cart)
- {F12} Payment (cash, card, gift card, check, store credit, split)
- {Ctrl+C} Checkout / Payment (when no text is selected)
- {Ctrl+L} Order history (reprint, return with receipt)
- {Ctrl+H} Hold
- {Ctrl+Shift+H} Load Hold (pick a held order)
- {Ctrl+D} Open Drawer
- {Ctrl+R} Return (no receipt): next scans go in as returns, red; press again to stop
- {Ctrl+F} Product search
- {Ctrl+P} Reprint last receipt (prints straight away)
- {Ctrl+Alt+P} Gift receipt for the last sale (no prices, prints straight away)
- {F6} Sale discount (order discount)
- {+} Quantity +1 on selected line
- {-} Quantity -1 on selected line
- {*} Quantity: type * then the number and Enter (e.g. *5) — sets the last / selected line
- {Delete} Remove selected line
- {Escape} Close window / back to sale
- {Ctrl+Shift+O} Back to the sale screen
- {F5} Tax Off: no tax on this sale (press again to put tax back). Browser reload stays blocked.
- {Ctrl+Shift+X} Clock out (count the drawer, then log out)
- {F3} Customer (find, add, edit, remove)
- {F4} Item discount / tax for the selected line
- {F7} Temporary Item: type a price (name optional), Enter adds it
- {F8} Extra charge (fee)
- {F9} Promo code
- {Ctrl+E} End of day: X / Z reports, cash in / out
- {Ctrl+K} Cash in / out (choose Pay In or Pay Out)
- {Ctrl+,} Settings
- {Ctrl+1} Settings: Printer & Drawer tab
- {Ctrl+2} Settings: Returns tab
- {Ctrl+3} Settings: Screen tab
- {Ctrl+4} Settings: Touch tab
- {Ctrl+5} Settings: Bulk items tab
- {Ctrl+6} Settings: Buttons tab
- {Ctrl+7} Settings: Remote help tab
- {Ctrl+8} Settings: Labels tab (label printer, sticker size, what the label shows)
- {Ctrl+9} Settings: Cards tab (typed cards and cards on file for Sola stores)
- {Ctrl+Shift+P} Print Label: scan items to print price stickers on the label printer (the sale is not changed)
- {Ctrl+N} Sale note (prints under the receipt)
- {F10} Add Gift Receipt: a no-price gift receipt prints with this sale (press again to remove)
- {Alt+N} Sale note (same as Ctrl+N)
- {Ctrl+I} Price check (shows price and stock, adds nothing)
- {Ctrl+Shift+A} Put Aside (park this sale on this PC)
- {Ctrl+Shift+L} Load Aside (bring back a parked sale)
- {Ctrl+Shift+F} Find a line in this sale
- {Ctrl+Shift+C} Calculator
- {Ctrl+G} Gift card: sell or reload one card (balance check is in the right panel)
- {Ctrl+Shift+G} Sell several gift cards (one amount, scan cards one after another)
- {Ctrl+=} Zoom in (remembered on this PC)
- {Ctrl+-} Zoom out
- {Ctrl+0} Zoom back to 100%
- {Ctrl+Alt+=} Zoom in
- {Ctrl+Alt+-} Zoom out
- {Ctrl+Shift+S} Quick search box in the side panel
- {Shift+F3} Clear customer from this sale
- {Ctrl+Shift+B} Gift card balance
- {Ctrl+Shift+D} Hardware check (printer / drawer)
- {Ctrl+Shift+U} Log out
- {Ctrl+B} Hide / show the side panels
- {Alt+1} Bulk item button 1
- {Alt+2} Bulk item button 2
- {Alt+3} Bulk item button 3
- {Alt+4} Bulk item button 4
- {Alt+5} Bulk item button 5
- {Alt+6} Bulk item button 6
- {Alt+7} Bulk item button 7
- {Alt+8} Bulk item button 8
- {Alt+9} Bulk item button 9
- {Alt+0} Bulk item button 10
- {Alt+-} Bulk item button 11
- {Alt+=} Bulk item button 12
- {Alt+Backspace} Bulk items: back to folders
- {Alt+letter} In a window: the button marked Alt + that letter
Source: Keys
